pros: Highly customizable to fit diverse workflows and team needs.
Efficient task creation and management with intuitive UI elements.
Offers a wide range of views (e.g., Kanban, List) readily available.
Excellent for centralizing many aspects of project and team work.
Real-time updates and smooth dragging/dropping in task views.
Strong feature set for various project management methodologies.
cons: Significant learning curve due to the sheer number of features and customization options.
Can feel overwhelming or cluttered, especially when setting up custom fields or views.
Performance issues can arise, with the interface sometimes feeling slow or sluggish.
The mobile app experience is often less refined and functional than the desktop version.
Custom field creation and management can be cumbersome and not always intuitive.
Pricing model can become expensive for larger teams or advanced features.
